obligations.expected_outcome: A Session sees Activity facts only from its resolved Workspace; foreign source IDs yield no items or existence leak.

obligations.expected_outcome: Evaluation produces only current-revision Activity facts with owner classification and the status-specific authoritative time, keyed by platform run_id.

obligations.expected_outcome: Creation produces Workspace-scoped Session Activity facts with owner classification, updated_at, stable session identity and exact continuation identifiers.
obligations.check: Creation fact-reader contract and serialization tests

obligations.expected_outcome: Packaging produces Workspace-scoped Artifact Activity facts with defensive status classification, created_at, stable Artifact UUID and exact continuation identifiers without clock-derived reclassification.
obligations.check: Packaging fact-reader contract and serialization tests

obligations.expected_outcome: Publishing produces Workspace-scoped Skill Publication Activity facts with owner classification, status/Release time selection, stable publication_id and exact continuation identifiers.
obligations.check: Publishing fact-reader contract and serialization tests

obligations.expected_outcome: Every Run state and every Evaluation status/overall combination produces the approved owner classification; absent Evaluation is neutral, unknown or invalid Evaluation combinations are safe needs_attention/unsupported, and mechanical priority yields needs_attention before in_progress before recent before neutral.

obligations.expected_outcome: Run creation, persisted accepted transitions and accepted cancellation requests move activity_updated_at; rejected or duplicate no-op cancellation, Trace and cleanup do not. Pending Evaluation uses current created_at, completed or failed Evaluation uses current evaluated_at, a new current revision supersedes the old time, and old-revision feedback or suggestion changes do not move Activity.

obligations.expected_outcome: All Creation states map to the approved classification, updated_at is preserved as activity_at, and pending_action changes presentation without client-side reclassification.

obligations.expected_outcome: Available maps to recent; defensive quarantined and rejected map to needs_attention; created_at remains activity_at; expiry, purge and object loss do not reclassify or move time; deleted Artifacts are absent.
obligations.check: Packaging available and defensive-state table with expiry, purge, object-loss and deletion cases

obligations.expected_outcome: Publication status and latest Release produce the approved classification; with a Release the later status_changed_at or released_at wins, without a Release status_changed_at is the explicit fallback; exposure, availability and Bundle changes do not move the Skill Publication item.
